title: Meriwest empowers non-SMEs and drops vendor review from 6 to <3 weeks - Kobalt Labs
summary: Founded in 1961, Meriwest Credit Union is one of Silicon Valley's most established financial institutions. As it scaled its vendor partnerships, Kobalt automated the review process — halving onboarding time and giving its risk team full visibility in minutes.
body_markdown:
## The story


Founded in 1961, Meriwest Credit Union is one of Silicon Valley's most established financial institutions, serving over 80,000 families and businesses in the Bay Area with a wide range of financial services and $2.1B in AUM.


As Meriwest scaled its partnerships with third-party vendors, managing risk and accelerating vendor onboarding became a key operational priority.


## The challenge


Before Kobalt, Meriwest's vendor risk team faced slow, manual onboarding:


-


Vendor documents varied wildly in structure and completeness


-


Reviewing policies, procedures, security reports, and contracts meant looping in multiple subject-matter experts and internal stakeholders


-


Blaine, who manages vendor risk for Meriwest, waited days for internal input and vendor responses


-


Full onboarding took at least six weeks, delaying revenue-generating partnerships


-


Contract reviews meant 15-person meetings going point-by-point through documents


## The solution


Meriwest brought in Kobalt to streamline and automate the review process:


-


The moment a vendor packet arrives, the team uploads every document into Kobalt


-


After an initial analysis, Meriwest already knows which risk-mitigation information is missing and what to request for SMEs


-


Vendors now typically send missing items on day one, dramatically reducing back-and-forth


-


Kobalt's analysis lets Meriwest respond to packet delivery within the day


-


A deeper review highlights specific regulatory citations and contract risks, giving SMEs precise focus areas


-


Contract reviews shifted from full-team meetings to asynchronous review of Kobalt's flagged risks


Implementation was immediate — no engineering required.


## The impact


### For the vendor risk team


-


Onboarding dropped from 6+ weeks to under 3 — and shrinking with broader rollout


-


Automatic reviews across BC/DR, privacy, infosec, and more


-


Full visibility into missing risk-mitigation information within minutes of uploading a packet


-


SME time preserved — no more preliminary meetings or premature involvement


> “It's made us subject-matter experts in every part of this process. Before, we'd be waiting on others to tell us what was missing or sufficient. Now I know exactly what's needed before anyone else gets involved.”


Blaine Brankis


· Vendor Risk & Resiliency Analyst, Meriwest Credit Union


### For contract management


-


Kobalt flagged contract terms — including unusual indemnification clauses — the team hadn't previously identified


-


Contract reviews became asynchronous and focused, cutting meetings and freeing time across departments


> “Kobalt quickly flags unusual indemnification terms and surfaces possible gaps — making our contract review better, smarter, and more proactive.”


Blaine Brankis


· Vendor Risk & Resiliency Analyst, Meriwest Credit Union


### For the organization


-


Increased confidence across leadership in the vendor risk program


-


Stronger cross-functional engagement — when stakeholders are pulled in, they know their time is well spent


> “It's made our entire vendor risk program stronger, more efficient, and focused. We've been able to provide a higher level of service to our internal partners. People are more engaged because we can quickly get on the same page, address specific questions, and get contracts completed in a timely manner.”


Blaine Brankis


· Vendor Risk & Resiliency Analyst, Meriwest Credit Union


Featured products:


Third-Party Risk Management


Contract Management
